prompt: Security issue in Portal `ReleaseController`. GET /envs/{env}/releases/{releaseId} checks that the current user may view the release's namespace, but the compare endpoint (GET /envs/{env}/releases/compare?baseReleaseId=..&toCompareReleaseId=..) returns the diff of any two releases without any permission check, leaking configuration of namespaces the user cannot see. Apply the same per-release permission check used by the single-release endpoint to both releases in compare (a release id of 0 means 'no release' and is not checked).

oracle_plan.instruction: Extract the permission-checked release lookup from get() into a private method; in compareRelease load each non-zero release through it and compare the two loaded releases.
